directive.quote: An engine fix must reach accounts without any Mac app install.

job: Publish a signed engine release on every push to the branch, so every computer adopts it from a release feed

distinct_from.why: This tool itself: its README, rows, settings and tests name the signing domain, the release values and the push signature header it uses.
This tool's own capability row, whose owner names this folder: the registry entry for this tool, not another owner of the job.
The generated tool catalog (publish-tool-catalog.mjs): it carries this tool's own rows. A generated listing of this tool, not another owner of the job.
start-a-computer writes the release_feed a computer reads this tool's feed with, and its README names this folder as the feed's publisher; it starts places and publishes nothing.

The older product's Workers Builds deploy, removed at the commit this search names: it uploaded and promoted a hosted Worker version on each push to main. Its rule that an older commit never wins is kept here, but the job differs: this builds the engine program on a builder and signs a feed entry each computer adopts itself; nothing is uploaded or promoted.
The batching numbers of that removed Worker deploy; this tool's numbers are its own (read-data/settings.json).

phrasings: Publish a signed engine release on every push to the branch, so every computer adopts it from a release feed
build trillion-local at a commit with TRILLION_RELEASE_SEQUENCE and sign the release
